baseline_models.mechanism: The passive plural makes dispersed persons the object of convergence, while miqat supplies a preassigned rendezvous rather than a loose period.

activation_trace.role: Joining what was dispersed supplies the convergence, with the passive form making the persons its object.
A struck appointment supplies the fixed rendezvous toward which the gathering moves.

changed_reading.before: They will all be present at a known time.
changed_reading.after: Dispersed persons will be made to converge toward a preassigned rendezvous.

baseline_models.mechanism: The gathering is complete rather than merely numerous, and its day is an occurrence of exceptional weight rather than an ordinary calendar unit.

activation_trace.role: Wholeness without dispersal or loss makes the gathered plural an exhaustive total.
The day as a severe, momentous occurrence gives that totalization event-weight.

changed_reading.before: A large crowd will assemble on a day.
changed_reading.after: The momentous event gathers its entire human field without remainder.

baseline_models.mechanism: The stacked temporal terms make a bounded terminus, while ma'lum can make that terminus identifiable by a distinguishing mark, not merely known in someone's mind.

activation_trace.role: Setting a time or limit supplies the terminus's fixed boundary.
A duration rather than only daylight lets the boundary denote a whole event-span.
A distinguishing sign makes the appointed span marked and identifiable.

changed_reading.before: Known simply reports information about the date.
changed_reading.after: The convergence has a bounded and marked terminus that can be identified when reached.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated companionship joined to a side turns gathering from indiscriminate massing into consolidation and disclosure of a durable cohort.

activation_trace.role: A group or mixture held by one direction lets the gathering retain corporate differentiation.
Repeated companionship supplies a relation that persists with its members and becomes the cohort gathered.
The leftward side supplies the cohort's directional designation within the larger convergence.

structural_cues: 56:41 repeats both the companion noun and the side designation before the environmental sequence begins.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies repeated affiliation, a side, and focus gathering; I infer that convergence preserves and exposes affiliation, while the live alternative is that the phrase only labels the addressees.

changed_reading.before: Everyone is merged into an undifferentiated total.
changed_reading.after: The total gathering consolidates and makes visible the cohort relations people already carry.

context_deltas.mechanism: The fixed rendezvous becomes a threshold of entry into an enclosing condition: penetrating heat, soot-dark shelter, and a shade stripped of cooling and honor.

activation_trace.role: The struck appointment supplies the threshold at which the described condition takes effect.
A penetrating hot wind supplies exposure that enters rather than merely surrounds the gathered.
Soot, smoke, and darkness turn the apparent shelter into part of the harmful enclosure.
Shade supplies the expected shelter whose function is then reversed.
Cooling supplies the denied protective effect of that shade.
Honorable beneficence supplies the second denied function, making the environment inhospitable as well as hot.

structural_cues: 56:42-44 is a locative sequence of being in heat and shade, while 56:50 uses إلى to point toward the appointment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a fixed rendezvous and an inverted shelter; I infer that arrival at the miqat activates an embodied condition, while the alternative is that the setting only precedes the summons rhetorically.

changed_reading.before: The miqat is a neutral date on a calendar.
changed_reading.after: The miqat is the scheduled threshold at which the gathered enter a total environment of exposure.

context_deltas.mechanism: Their active consolidation of resolve around wrongdoing is answered by passive consolidation of their own persons; the same coherence changes sides.

activation_trace.role: Gathered resolve after divided thought supplies the focus-side image of coherence, now borne passively by the people.
Persistence and determination supply the active coherence they formerly maintained.
Sin and liability supply the object around which that persistence was organized.

structural_cues: 56:45-46 uses repeated past habit before 56:50's emphatic passive participle.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies active persistence in wrongdoing and passive gathering; I infer an agency reversal from self-organized persistence to being organized for summons, while a simple causal sequence remains possible.

changed_reading.before: The verse only predicts where persistent wrongdoers will later stand.
changed_reading.after: Those who once consolidated their resolve are themselves made into the consolidated object of the summons.

context_deltas.mechanism: Death, dust, and bones give gathering a material problem to solve, while the stirring of what lay still supplies the transition from dispersed remains to an assembled total.

activation_trace.role: Joining dispersed parts makes the promised gathering answer material disintegration, not only social distance.
Loss of life and power supplies the initial dismantling that gathering must overcome.
Earth and dust supply dispersed material rather than an intact waiting body.
Solid bone supplies a residual part contrasted with the surrounding dust.
Stirring the still from rest supplies the transition by which scattered material can become gathered persons.

structural_cues: The skeptical question moves from death to dust and bones to passive raising, and 56:50 answers with another emphatic passive plural.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies decomposition, stirring, and joining the dispersed; I infer that gathering includes reconstructive collection, while the live alternative is that resurrection is complete before a merely social assembly.

changed_reading.before: Already restored people will later be brought into one crowd.
changed_reading.after: The gathering itself answers dispersal into dust and bones by carrying a reconstructive, material force.

context_deltas.mechanism: First and last set the endpoints of history, while the alternate mapped branch of first contributes succession; the one miqat synchronizes that serial human stream into complete co-presence.

activation_trace.role: Completeness without loss makes the convergence span the whole historical field.
One struck appointment supplies the common temporal coordinate for all generations.
Beginning and precedence supply history's early endpoint.
Succession one after another supplies the serial flow that the appointment compresses into co-presence.
Lastness supplies history's late endpoint.

structural_cues: 56:48 expands the question to forefathers, and 56:49 answers with the merism of the first and the last immediately before the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ancestral extension, historical endpoints, serial succession, and one appointment; I infer temporal synchronization, while the alternative is simply exhaustive quantification without emphasis on collapsed sequence.

changed_reading.before: The verse gathers the complete population of one era.
changed_reading.after: One appointment synchronizes the successive generations from history's first edge to its last.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate address to the lost deniers turns ma'lum into an epistemic counterclaim: their failed orientation and refusal do not make the appointed event indeterminate.

activation_trace.role: Disclosure to a knower supplies objective determinacy against the addressees' refusal.
A distinguishing sign supplies public identifiability, not private information alone.
Deviation from guidance and intended direction supplies the failed orientation answered by a fixed, marked terminus.
Attributing the claim to falsehood supplies the denial that ma'lum polemically resists.

structural_cues: 56:51 follows the known day with ثم and a direct vocative naming the lost deniers.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ma'lum followed by straying and denial; I infer a deliberate epistemic opposition, while the alternative is that ma'lum remains only a calendrical modifier.

changed_reading.before: Known is a neutral adjective attached to the day.
changed_reading.after: Known asserts the appointment's stable legibility precisely against those who deny and lose their bearings.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus vector إلى ميقات and a gathering whose parts catch up reverse straying and aimless movement: divergent trajectories are forced to terminate together.

activation_trace.role: Motion gathering force until its parts catch up supplies convergent trajectories rather than a static crowd.
The fixed appointment supplies the unavoidable endpoint of those trajectories.
Straying from the intended direction supplies one form of divergent motion.
Going about without aim through confusion supplies the second trajectory that the fixed vector reverses.

structural_cues: The focus uses إلى toward a miqat; the post-focus sequence names the lost and ends its drinking image with hīm.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies directional grammar, straying, aimless movement, and convergent motion; I infer coerced vector correction, while the alternative is that hīm contributes only thirst to the drinking simile.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is a static placement at a date.
changed_reading.after: Even trajectories defined by straying and aimlessness are made to converge on one unavoidable endpoint.

context_deltas.mechanism: The miqat becomes a scheduled arrival whose reception is already prepared, while the day of account determines the character of that bitter provision.

activation_trace.role: A struck appointment supplies the scheduled arrival.
The day as a severe occurrence supplies the event character of that arrival.
Provision prepared for an arriving guest supplies an ironic reception already waiting at the appointment.
Accounting and requital supply the rule that determines the reception.

structural_cues: The eating and drinking sequence closes with هذا نزلهم يوم الدين, naming the provision and the event-day together.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies an appointment, prepared provision, and accounting; I infer that the hospitality frame reaches backward to cast the miqat as scheduled arrival, while the alternative limits nuzul to the meal after assembly.

changed_reading.before: The appointed day merely tells when the gathering occurs.
changed_reading.after: The appointment is a scheduled arrival into a reception already prepared under the logic of account.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because the shackle image is peripheral to the ordinary passive participle, but it remains anchored in the supplied ج م ع branch and the coercive passive; downstream prose should present it only as an undertone of constrained assembly, not as the lexical gloss.

activation_trace.role: A restraint joining hands to neck supplies coercive binding as an extreme image of being gathered.

changed_reading.before: The people are simply assembled in one location.
changed_reading.after: The passive gathering carries a possible undertone of being bound into an inescapable collective condition.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is a cross-scale material analogy, surprising because the large gathered fullness branch is not the ordinary sense of majmu'un; it remains anchored by that focus branch and the explicit filling of bellies, and should be qualified as a spatial echo rather than a translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: لَمَجْمُوعُونَ as a gathered, full total

activation_trace.role: Greatness figured as gathered fullness supplies a macro-container image for the assembled total.
Filling until contents equal the vessel supplies the repeated operation at the bodily scale.
The belly as an interior supplies the explicit micro-container receiving that filling.

changed_reading.before: Gathering is only an external crowd relation.
changed_reading.after: The gathered total can be heard as macro-scale filling, grimly echoed when each person's interior is filled.

strongest_changes: Dust, bones, and ba'th revise social assembly into a materially reconstructive gathering.
The first, the last, and succession make one miqat synchronize the full historical stream.
The surrounding exposure and prepared nuzul turn a bare date into a threshold and scheduled arrival under account.
summary.what_was_special: The focus's passive gathering sits between skeptical material decomposition and a post-focus sequence of denial, forced intake, and prepared provision, so material, temporal, social, directional, and container readings remain simultaneously traceable.
remaining_uncertainties: The packet does not decide whether reconstructive collection belongs inside gathering or is completed by ba'th before assembly.
Ma'lum may polemically answer denial, or it may remain only a known-date modifier.
The exposure-threshold, hospitality, restraint, and filling models depend on analogical extension and should not displace the direct convergence model.
